figures.caption: Effect of various concentrations of WRK on A: glial cancerous (C6), and healthy (Astrocytes) cells; B: prostatic cancerous (LNCap) and healthy (RWPE) cells; C: peripheral mononuclear cancerous (Jurkat) and healthy (MNC) cells. Results are expressed as the percentage of cell permeabilization in comparison to the negative (PBS buffer) and positive (0.1% Triton X-100) controls. Experiments were performed in triplicates, and the results are expressed as means. Bar scales indicate standard deviation.
figures.label: Fig 1
